summary: TriLinc Global Impact Fund LLC filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 providing a routine portfolio update as of April 30, 2026. The filing discloses aggregate portfolio assets of approximately $283 million, weighted average loan size of ~$10 million, and duration of 0.4 years. It notes cumulative funded investments of ~$1.210 billion across 103 borrowers, with $905.2 million in aggregate repayments. No material definitive agreement, corporate transaction, tender offer, or special-situation event is announced. This is a standard periodic business update with no structural or strategic change requiring classification as a special situation.
